name: Third-Party Binary Inventory
description: Catalog all third-party binaries (Electron, native modules, sidecars). Version, hash, license, and provenance.
purpose: Establish a complete catalog of every third-party binary shipped with the project so their licenses, versions, hashes, and provenance are traceable and auditable.
acceptanceCriteria: All third-party binaries (Electron framework, native Node modules, sidecar executables) are discovered and cataloged.
Each entry includes: name, version, SHA-256 hash, license type, and provenance source.
Provenance source is recorded (downloaded from official source, built from source, vendored).
Inventory is automatically regenerated when dependencies change.
Inventory includes a diff summary against the previous release's inventory.
Unaccounted binaries (present in artifact but not in inventory) trigger a CI warning.
Inventory is published alongside the release artifacts.
